subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar os efeitos de sentido provocados pela seleção lexical, topicalização de elementos e seleção e hierarquização de informações, uso de 3ª pessoa etc.

components.description_pt: Avaliar o impacto das escolhas lexicais específicas do autor sobre o significado e tom em um texto
components.description_en: Evaluate the impact of an author's specific word choices on meaning and tone in a text
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the impact of an author's specific word choices on meaning and tone in a text

components.description_pt: Identificar como a topicalização de elementos e hierarquização de informações moldam o significado em textos
components.description_en: Identify how topicalization of elements and hierarchization of information shape meaning in texts
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author's choice of structure affects the communication of information

components.description_pt: Interpretar o efeito do uso da terceira pessoa sobre a objetividade ou posicionamento transmitido em um texto
components.description_en: Interpret the effect of using third person on the objectivity or stance conveyed in a text
components.cc_component_description: Contrast how first-person and third-person narration affect a reader's experience of a story

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts by
* Identifying and __summarizing__ main ideas and key details
* __Analyzing details and examples for key attributes, qualities, and characteristics__
* __Evaluating the impact of key word choices in a text__
Compare and contrast the point of view from which different stories are narrated, including the difference between first- and third-person narrations.
Compare and contrast the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more texts.
